title: AgentModel
description: A model of an engine's installation, as the clients read it (plan 13, B-13; plan 28, B-36) — discovered from the engine, never a list in the code.

resolvedModel.description: The id an alias resolves to, when the installation says.

displayName.description: Data of the installation, shown as it is — like the description of a slash command.

supportedEffortLevels.description: The levels of effort this model takes — empty when it takes none.

supportsEffort.description: Whether the model takes an effort at all, said by whether `supportedEffortLevels` is empty — kept on the wire for clients that read the flag rather than the list.
